editorial.blurb: Usmania serves authentic, generously portioned desi cuisine in a clean, well-maintained space where the kitchen shines brightest.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the buffet on your first visit to sample their range—both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options are solid—but note that it can feel a bit confusing to navigate; alternatively, order the matka mutton biryani or chicken 65 for delivery to skip variable service experiences.
